cited.quote: Necessary action will be taken with Union Government for establishing Zonal Sub Centre of Coconut Development Board at

rationale: C2 is a budget speech stating that action will be taken with the Union Government to establish a Zonal Sub Centre of the Coconut Development Board; this is a statement of intent, not an official step. C1 plans integrated farming generally. No GO or launch for the sub-regional centre.

cited.quote: Common Effluent Treatment Plants will be revitalized and new CETPs will be set up in the Erode and Namakkal clusters.

rationale: C2 is a budget plan for the state to revitalise CETPs and set up new ones in Erode and Namakkal; it is not a formal step urging the Union government for assistance. No resolution, letter or GO pressing the Centre appears in the extracts.

The promise refers to separate investigation sections for unspecified matters. C1 (AEFI investigation), C2 (DPC procedure), C3 (bonded labour SOP), C4 (school safety) and C5 (exam guidelines) are not about creating such sections.

cited.quote: towards the distribution of any of the agricultural machinery namely Tractors, Combine Harvesters
it is proposed to distribute 7,106 agricultural machinery and implements with subsidy assistance to the farmers

rationale: Directional promise. C4 is a GO dated 2021-06-01 sanctioning SMAM implementation in 2021-22 with financial assistance for farmers to procure machinery including combine harvesters. C1 is only a budget plan. The GO revalidates an existing scheme, so some doubt whether it is a new measure.
C1-C5 are lists of private hospitals empanelled under health insurance schemes; none is about equipping government district hospitals to perform heart surgeries.

cited.quote: those farmers who struggle at the national capital with brave hearts to agitate against the farm laws

rationale: C1 only mentions farmers agitating against the farm laws in a budget speech dedication; no extract shows a bill or enactment repealing state farm laws. C2-C5 concern crop insurance, horticulture and mechanisation.

cited.quote: This Government will modernize the 34 existing bus stands and provide modern integrated bus stands in major cities.

rationale: C4 is a budget statement of intent on bus stands in general; C2 lists modern bus stands as permissible KNMT works without naming the pilgrim towns; C1 and C3 concern a bus stand at Gandarvakottai. No official step for bus stations or accommodation at the named places.
None of C1-C5 (child protection, Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam, bonded labour SOP, health worker contracts, SVEP funds) is about appointing 25,000 women community welfare workers under BDOs.

cited.quote: a total sum of Rs.303.66 crore has been provided for fishing ban period relief assistance

rationale: C1 is a budget allocation for fishing ban period relief but gives no increase from Rs 5000 to Rs 8000; C4 merely lists the service online. No GO raising the amount.

C2 and C3 concern release of MSME capital subsidy; C1, C4, C5 concern farm machinery, agriculture and crop insurance. None is about a 25% subsidy with loans to women SHGs for products procured by government.

cited.quote: This Government will also urge that in all Union Government offices including nationalized banks

rationale: C1, the Governor's address, states the government will urge that Tamil be co-official in Union offices and nationalized banks; this is a statement of intent, not a formal step such as an Assembly resolution or CM's letter. C2 concerns Tamil in state departments.
No extract mentions the Kannika sluice gate or irrigation for Nellai, Thoothukudi and Virudhunagar; C1-C5 cover desilting in delta, budget plans, industrial parks and TNAU projects.
C1-C3 describe existing public libraries and digitisation; C4-C5 allow modern libraries as urban works generally. None is about establishing libraries in the hometowns of the named poets.
No extract concerns interest rates of Handloom Cooperative Societies; C1-C2 are RTI subject allocations, C3 pension interest, C4 SHG loan waiver and petrol tax, C5 an inspection report.

cited.quote: This Government will also urge the Union Government to make necessary laws and amendments to grant Indian citizenship

rationale: C1, the Governor's address, says the government will urge the Union to grant citizenship to Sri Lankan Tamil refugees; this is intent, not a formal advocacy step (resolution, CM letter, GO). Other extracts are unrelated.
C2 and C5 amend retirement age and notional increment rules, C1 DPC guidelines, C3-C4 urban employment scheme; none is about giving retired personnel priority in eligible jobs.

The promise is an age-linked 10% hike at 70 and 80 years in a scheme. C1-C2 fix pension-fund interest rates, C3 mentions revamping old age pension coverage, C4 pension expenditure, C5 bus norms; none concerns such age-based hikes.
No extract mentions sea erosion barriers or groynes along the coast; C1 covers fishing harbours, C2 salt production, C3 geo-heritage, C4 Kuruvai package, C5 police postings.

rationale: C1 is a budget speech announcing a decision to cut petrol tax by Rs.3 per litre (less than Rs 5, no diesel cut); a budget announcement is not operationalisation and no GO or notification appears in the extracts.
C1-C3 are empty scheme pages, C4 pensioners' life certificates, C5 medical PG admission; none is about lifetime validity of TET certificates.
